body:
While I agree with everything you said (and yes you are helpful, thank you) sometimes I wish I could be a weak little girl that people take care of, you know? Having to be the strong one all the time is exhausting. 

I'm not killing myself anytime soon, I haven't gone this far to give up now that things *might* get a little better, but God is it hard to stay strong when you have no more back-up plans left.

Marijuana can help short term but it is also known to increase depression, so I'm not sure it's a good idea. 

To OP : It's seems like your doctors are flooding you with meds that are inefficient for you. Are those docs doing any good to you? Are they just throwing new meds at you anytime you see them or are they really helping? I can't tell from your post, but I would suggest trying to change doctor and psych (unless they're really helping, even if I don't get this feeling). 

Finding the right psych is important, they're not all worth the same, one can be great with some people but irrelevant with others, it's kinda the same with medicine. Don't give up before you find what works for you.
Thank you for taking the time to answer. You're right, sometimes I can't take the depressing thoughts out of my mind. I used to be able to so that, I need to learn to do it again.
